instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: I am very ((attached)) to my cat.
atoms.finishSound: I am very attached to my cat.

atoms.b: Which ((category)) did you compete in at sports day?
atoms.finishSound: Which category did you compete in at sports day?

atoms.b: The lawyer tried to ((persuade)) her client to accept the offer.
atoms.finishSound: The lawyer tried to persuade her client to accept the offer.

atoms.b: The runners need a ((definite)) starting point to make sure the race is fair.
atoms.finishSound: The runners need a definite starting point to make sure the race is fair.

atoms.b: The kitchen is ((equipped)) with a brand new oven.
atoms.finishSound: The kitchen is equipped with a brand new oven.

atoms.b: It’s so nice to see a ((familiar)) face here!
atoms.finishSound: It’s so nice to see a familiar face here!
